headline: ASAKE BRINGS IN GOD WE TRUST TO BROOKLYN
caption:
@mrmoney brings the In God We Trust World Tour to Brooklyn's Barclays Center tonight, August 26, with Uncle Waffles joining the bill. The 8:30 p.m. show puts Asake's current M$NEY era on one of New York City's biggest arena stages.

Source: @barclayscenter and Live Nation
